q20466.en: The sign shown is a priority sign.

explain.short: The give way triangle belongs to the family of priority signs (segnali di precedenza).
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'segnale di precedenza' is the right family: it is about who goes first.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: a priority sign

q20467.en: The sign shown obliges you to give way to vehicles coming both from the right and from the left.

explain.short: At a give way sign you let everyone on the other road pass, whichever side they come from.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'sia da destra che da sinistra' (both right and left) is correct: not only the right.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to the right AND to the left

keywords.it: sia da destra che da sinistra
keywords.en: both from the right and from the left

q20468.en: The sign shown means you must give way to vehicles travelling on the road you are crossing.

explain.short: The other road has priority, so its vehicles go first and you wait.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'strada che si incrocia' is the other road at the junction: its traffic goes first.

sceneParams.caption: The other road goes first

q20469.en: The sign shown is placed on a minor road that does not have priority.

explain.short: Give way is put on the minor road, the one that must wait at the junction.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'strada secondaria' (minor road) is right: the main road never has this sign.

sceneParams.caption: On the minor road, at the junction

keywords.it: non ha il diritto di precedenza

q20470.en: The sign shown is found on acceleration lanes for joining the motorway.

explain.short: When you join a motorway, traffic already on it has priority, so give way is placed where you join.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'corsie di accelerazione' (acceleration lanes) are a real place for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Joining the motorway: give way

q20471.en: On country roads, the sign shown is preceded by the ADVANCE GIVE WAY sign.

explain.short: Outside towns drivers go faster, so an advance sign warns them before the give way junction.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' (roads outside towns) is where the advance sign is used.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: advance sign first

q20472.en: The sign shown tells you to slow down a lot and to stop if necessary.

explain.short: You must arrive slowly enough to stop if a vehicle is coming on the other road.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'all'occorrenza' means only if needed: stopping is not always required.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down a lot, stop only if needed

q20473.en: With the sign shown, you do not need to stop at the junction if, while slowing down, you can see that no vehicles are coming from the right or the left.

explain.short: Give way is not STOP: if the road is clearly empty, you may go on without stopping.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'non occorre fermarsi' is right here: only STOP always needs a full stop.

sceneParams.caption: Road clear? No need to stop

q20474.en: The sign shown may be preceded by the PRIORITY ROAD sign.

explain.short: Give way is on the road WITHOUT priority, so a priority road sign cannot come before it.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA' (priority road) is the opposite situation: it is for the main road.

sceneParams.caption: Minor road: no priority road sign before it

q20475.en: The sign shown is used on roads that have priority.

explain.short: Give way is used on roads that do NOT have priority: you are the one who waits.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'godono del diritto di precedenza' (have priority) is the opposite of the truth.

sceneParams.caption: Used on roads WITHOUT priority

q20476.en: As a rule, the sign shown is placed 150 metres before the junction.

explain.short: The give way sign stands at the junction itself; 150 m before is where the advance sign goes.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: '150 metri prima' is the place of the advance sign (preavviso), not of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Placed AT the junction, not 150 m before

q20477.en: Along motorways, the sign shown is placed at a distance greater than 150 m.

explain.short: Give way is placed right where you must give way, also at motorway entries, not at a distance.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'a distanza maggiore di 150 m' is invented: the sign is at the point where you give way.

sceneParams.caption: At the point where you give way

q20478.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop before entering the junction.

explain.short: Give way obliges you to stop only if vehicles are coming; the always-stop sign is STOP.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'obbliga a fermarsi' (obliges to stop) describes STOP, not give way.

sceneParams.caption: Stop only if someone is coming

q20479.en: The sign shown is found only on urban roads.

explain.short: Give way is used in towns and outside towns, and also at motorway entries.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the sign is used on every kind of road.

sceneParams.caption: In towns AND outside towns

q20480.en: The sign shown is a general danger sign.

explain.short: This is a priority sign; the general danger sign is a triangle pointing up with an exclamation mark.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'segnale generico di pericolo' (general danger) is a different sign, with a '!'.

sceneParams.caption: Priority sign, not a danger sign

q20481.en: With the sign shown, you must give way on the left only to trams and emergency vehicles.

explain.short: You must give way to ALL vehicles on the other road, from the left and from the right.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' (give way) is placed at the junction on the minor road: let traffic from both right and left pass. Stop only if someone is coming.
explain.trap: 'solo ai tram e ai veicoli in servizio di emergenza' is invented: everyone has priority over you.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to everyone, both sides

q20482.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: Give way gives you an order (let others pass), so it is a prescription sign.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'segnale di prescrizione' is right: priority signs are a type of prescription sign.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: an order to follow

q20483.en: The sign shown obliges you to give way to vehicles travelling on the road you are entering.

explain.short: The road you are entering has priority, so its vehicles pass first.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'strada su cui ci si immette' (road you enter) is the road whose traffic goes first.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic on the road you enter goes first

keywords.it: strada su cui ci si immette

q20484.en: If the sign shown is combined with a traffic light, its rule applies when the light is flashing yellow.

explain.short: A flashing yellow light gives no order, so the give way sign tells you what to do.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'luce gialla lampeggiante' (flashing yellow) is exactly when the sign takes over.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: the sign rules

q20485.en: The sign shown is found on slip roads for joining the motorway.

explain.short: Traffic on the motorway has priority, so the slip road that joins it has give way.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'rampe di raccordo' (slip roads) are a real place for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slip road: give way to the motorway

q20486.en: The sign shown requires the greatest care in order to avoid accidents.

explain.short: You must check both sides and enter only when it is safe: maximum care.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'massima prudenza' (greatest care) is right for every junction where you give way.

sceneParams.caption: Maximum care at the junction

q20487.en: The sign shown may be preceded by the ADVANCE STOP sign.

explain.short: The advance STOP sign comes before a STOP; give way is preceded by the advance give way sign.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'FERMARSI E DARE PRECEDENZA' is STOP, a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Advance give way, not advance STOP

keywords.it: preavviso di fermarsi e dare precedenza

q20488.en: Along motorways, the sign shown is placed 150 metres from the service area.

explain.short: Give way has nothing to do with service areas: it is placed where you join a road with priority.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'area di servizio' (service area) is a made-up link.

sceneParams.caption: At the joining point, not for service areas

q20489.en: The sign shown warns you to stop before entering the junction.

explain.short: Give way does not make you always stop; you stop only if someone is coming.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'arrestarsi' (to stop) is what STOP orders, not give way.

sceneParams.caption: Stop only if needed

q20490.en: The sign shown is found only on roads outside towns.

explain.short: Give way is used both in towns and outside towns.
explain.rule: 'Dare precedenza' is a prescription sign: give way to traffic on the road you enter, from both sides, with great care. It is valid when the traffic light flashes yellow.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the sign is used everywhere.

sceneParams.caption: In towns AND outside towns

q20491.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the stop line and to give way to other vehicles.

explain.short: STOP means a full stop at the white stop line, then you let the other vehicles pass.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'striscia trasversale di arresto' (stop line) is exactly where you must stop.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the line, then give way

q20492.en: The sign shown requires you to stop and give way before entering the junction.

explain.short: STOP makes you stop before the junction and then give way.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'arrestarsi e dare la precedenza' (stop and give way) is the full name of STOP.

sceneParams.caption: Stop, then give way

q20493.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the junction and to give way to the right and to the left.

explain.short: After stopping, you let vehicles from both sides pass.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left) is correct: both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Stop, give way right AND left

q20494.en: The sign shown requires you to stop at the junction even when there is a traffic light flashing yellow.

explain.short: A flashing yellow light gives no order, so the STOP sign applies and you must stop.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'anche' (even) is right: flashing yellow does not cancel STOP.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: STOP still applies

q20495.en: The sign shown is found at a junction with a road that has priority.

explain.short: STOP is on the minor road where it meets a road with priority.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'strada con diritto di precedenza' (road with priority) is the other road, not yours.

sceneParams.caption: Minor road meets priority road

q20496.en: The sign shown is found, in general, at junctions with poor visibility.

explain.short: If you cannot see the other road well while moving, you must stop to look: that is why STOP is used.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'in genere' (in general) and 'scarsa visibilità' (poor visibility) fit the typical use.

sceneParams.caption: Poor visibility: stop and look

q20497.en: Outside built-up areas, the sign shown is preceded by its advance warning sign.

explain.short: Outside towns an advance sign ('STOP' with a distance) warns you before the STOP.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'fuori dei centri abitati' (outside towns) is where the advance sign is used.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: advance STOP sign first

q20498.en: As a rule, the sign shown is used at particularly dangerous junctions.

explain.short: STOP is chosen instead of give way where a junction is especially dangerous.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'particolare pericolosità' (particularly dangerous) is the typical reason for STOP.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous junction: STOP

q20499.en: The sign shown may be found at a level crossing.

explain.short: At some level crossings without barriers, a STOP makes you stop and look for trains.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'può' (may) is right: STOP can be used at a 'passaggio a livello' (level crossing).

sceneParams.caption: STOP can be at a level crossing

q20500.en: The sign shown warns of the obligation to stop and give way on alternate one-way roads.

explain.short: STOP is placed at the junction itself; it is not an advance sign and not for narrow alternate passages.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'sensi unici alternati' (alternate one-way passage) uses other priority signs (red and black arrows).

sceneParams.caption: STOP is at the junction, not a warning

q20501.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the customs post.

explain.short: STOP is a junction sign: stop and give way. Customs posts have their own signs.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'varco doganale' (customs post) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: STOP is for junctions, not customs

q20502.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop only if other vehicles cross your path.

explain.short: At STOP you must always stop, even when no vehicle is coming.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: STOP means a stop every time.

sceneParams.caption: ALWAYS stop, even with nobody coming

q20503.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop to give way only to vehicles coming from the right.

explain.short: After stopping you give way to vehicles from the right AND from the left.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'solo ... da destra' (only from the right) is the trap: both sides have priority.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to right AND left

q20504.en: As a rule, the sign shown is placed 150 metres before the junction.

explain.short: STOP stands at the junction itself, at the stop line; the advance sign is the one placed before.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: '150 metri prima' is the place of the advance sign, not of STOP.

sceneParams.caption: STOP is AT the junction

q20505.en: The sign shown requires you to stop because transit is forbidden.

explain.short: You stop to give way, then you can go on: the road is not closed.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'transito è vietato' (no transit) is a different sign, the red ring.

sceneParams.caption: Stop and give way, then go

q20506.en: The sign shown warns you to stop at the junction even if the traffic light is green.

explain.short: When a traffic light is working with red, yellow and green, the light wins over the STOP sign.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'anche se il semaforo emette luce verde' is the trap: with green you may go.

sceneParams.caption: Working green light wins over STOP

q20507.en: The sign shown warns of the obligation to stop at a police checkpoint.

explain.short: STOP is a junction sign. Police checkpoints use the 'ALT' sign or an officer's signal.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (police checkpoint) is not shown by STOP.

sceneParams.caption: STOP is for junctions, not police

q20508.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop only if other vehicles are approaching.

explain.short: At STOP you must always stop, even if the road is empty.
explain.rule: STOP: always stop completely at the stop line, even if the road is empty, then give way to traffic from right and left.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) is the trap: the stop is compulsory every time.

sceneParams.caption: ALWAYS stop, even on an empty road

q20509.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: The advance give way sign belongs to the priority signs, which are prescription signs.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'segnale di prescrizione' is right, even if it only announces the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Advance give way: prescription sign

q20510.en: The sign shown is an advance warning to give way both to the right and to the left.

explain.short: It announces a give way junction, where you let traffic from both sides pass.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'sia a destra che a sinistra' (both right and left) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Ahead: give way right AND left

keywords.it: sia a destra che a sinistra

q20511.en: The sign shown announces that a GIVE WAY sign is coming up.

explain.short: The triangle plus distance panel tells you a give way sign is ahead.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' (announces) is the job of an advance sign.

sceneParams.caption: Give way sign ahead

q20512.en: The sign shown indicates the distance to the junction where we must give way.

explain.short: The panel '320 m' is the distance to the give way junction.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'indica la distanza' (shows the distance) is what the panel does.

sceneParams.caption: The panel: distance to give way

q20513.en: The sign shown warns you to slow down so that you can stop if there are vehicles you must give way to.

explain.short: You slow down early so you can stop at the junction if someone is coming.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'per potersi fermare se ci sono veicoli' is right: stop only if needed.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, ready to stop if needed

q20514.en: The sign shown may announce a T junction where you must give way.

explain.short: The give way junction ahead can have any shape, also a T.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'può' (may) and 'incrocio a T' (T junction) are both fine.

sceneParams.caption: Can be a T junction

q20515.en: The sign shown is placed on a road that does not have priority.

explain.short: It announces a give way, so it is on the road that must wait.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'non ha diritto di precedenza' (has no priority) is right.

sceneParams.caption: On the road without priority

q20516.en: The sign shown is an advance warning to stop and give way.

explain.short: The panel shows only '320 m', not 'STOP 320 m': it announces give way, not STOP.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'fermarsi' (stop) is the trap: the advance STOP panel has the word STOP on it.

sceneParams.caption: Panel without 'STOP': give way ahead

q20517.en: The sign shown gives the distance to the next STOP sign.

explain.short: The panel without the word STOP gives the distance to a give way sign.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'STOP' is the trap: this panel only says '320 m'.

sceneParams.caption: Distance to give way, not STOP

q20518.en: The sign shown indicates the distance to the junction where we will have to stop.

explain.short: At the give way junction you stop only if someone is coming, not always.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'obbligatoriamente fermarci' (must stop) describes STOP, not give way.

sceneParams.caption: Ahead: give way, stop only if needed

q20519.en: With the sign shown, you must stop at the next junction.

explain.short: The next junction has give way: you stop only if vehicles are coming.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'è obbligatorio fermarsi' (you must stop) is true only for STOP.

sceneParams.caption: Stop only if someone is coming

q20520.en: The sign shown announces a junction where the rule of giving way only to the right applies.

explain.short: At the junction ahead you give way to the right AND to the left.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'solo a destra' (only to the right) is the trap; that rule has the X sign.

sceneParams.caption: Ahead: give way to both sides

q20521.en: The sign shown announces a three-light traffic signal at 320 metres.

explain.short: The triangle announces a give way sign, not traffic lights.
explain.rule: The panel gives the distance to a junction where you must give way (right and left). Slow down; stop only if needed.
explain.trap: 'semaforo a tre luci' (traffic light) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Give way ahead, not a traffic light

q20522.en: The sign shown is an advance warning to stop and give way.

explain.short: The panel says 'STOP 320 m': it is the advance STOP sign.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'fermarsi e dare precedenza' is the official name of STOP: correct here.

sceneParams.caption: Advance STOP sign

q20523.en: The sign shown announces a STOP sign at 320 metres.

explain.short: The panel reads 'STOP 320 m': the STOP is 320 m ahead.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'a 320 metri' matches the number on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: STOP 320 m ahead

q20524.en: The sign shown warns you to stop at the next junction and to give way to the right and to the left.

explain.short: At the STOP ahead you must stop and let vehicles from both sides pass.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'a destra ed a sinistra' (right and left) is right: both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Next junction: stop, give way both sides

q20525.en: The sign shown warns you to stop 320 metres after the sign and give way.

explain.short: The STOP line is 320 m after this sign: there you stop and give way.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: '320 metri dopo il segnale' is the distance on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Stop 320 m after this sign

q20526.en: The sign shown tells you to slow down because a junction where you must stop and give way is near.

explain.short: You slow down now so you can stop at the STOP ahead.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'invita a rallentare' (tells you to slow down) is right for an advance sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: STOP ahead

q20527.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: The advance STOP sign is a priority sign, and priority signs are prescription signs.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'segnale di prescrizione' is right, not a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Advance STOP: prescription sign

q20528.en: The sign shown only obliges you to slow down and, if necessary, give way at the junction at 320 metres.

explain.short: At the STOP ahead you must ALWAYS stop, not just slow down.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'solo a rallentare' (only slow down) is the trap: the panel says STOP.

sceneParams.caption: STOP ahead: a full stop, always

q20529.en: The sign shown is placed 320 metres from the GIVE WAY sign.

explain.short: It is 320 m from a STOP sign, not from a give way sign.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'DARE PRECEDENZA' is the trap: the panel says STOP.

sceneParams.caption: 320 m from STOP, not give way

q20530.en: The sign shown is found only on urban roads.

explain.short: The advance STOP sign is used mainly outside towns, so not only in towns.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Not only in towns

q20531.en: The sign shown announces a customs barrier.

explain.short: It announces a STOP at a junction, not customs.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'barriera doganale' (customs barrier) has its own sign.

sceneParams.caption: STOP junction ahead, not customs

q20532.en: The sign shown may announce a motorway toll booth.

explain.short: It announces a STOP at a junction; toll booths have their own signs.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'casello autostradale' (toll booth) is not linked to this sign.

sceneParams.caption: STOP junction ahead, not a toll booth

q20533.en: The sign shown is placed before the POLICE STOP sign.

explain.short: It comes before a STOP junction sign, not before the police 'ALT' sign.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'ALT-POLIZIA' is a different sign for police checks.

sceneParams.caption: Before a STOP sign, not police

q20534.en: When you meet the sign shown you must stop, and then stop again after 320 metres.

explain.short: At this sign you only slow down; you stop once, at the STOP 320 m ahead.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'occorre fermarsi e poi arrestarsi nuovamente' (stop twice) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down here, stop once at the STOP

q20535.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It looks like the give way triangle, a priority sign, so it is a prescription sign, not a danger sign.
explain.rule: 'STOP 320 m': in 320 m there is a STOP. There you must stop and give way to right and left; here you just slow down.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) is the trap: danger triangles point up.

sceneParams.caption: Priority sign, not danger

q20536.en: The sign shown announces a junction where the general rule of giving way to the right applies.

explain.short: The X in the triangle means a junction ahead with no priority road: give way to the right.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'regola generale' (general rule) is right: priority to the right.

sceneParams.caption: Junction ahead: give way to the right

q20537.en: The sign shown requires you to drive at a particularly moderate speed.

explain.short: A junction is coming where cars from the right go first, so you must slow down a lot.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'particolarmente moderata' (particularly moderate) is right near a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down a lot: junction ahead

q20538.en: The sign shown announces a junction where you must give way to the right.

explain.short: At the junction ahead, vehicles from your right go first.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'a destra' (to the right) is the meaning of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to the right

q20539.en: The sign shown is a priority sign.

explain.short: Even with its triangle shape, the Code lists it with the priority signs because it tells you who goes first.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'segnale di precedenza' is right, even if it looks like a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: X sign: listed with priority signs

q20540.en: The sign shown is not found on a stretch of road that has priority.

explain.short: On a priority road you go first, so a sign saying 'give way to the right' would be wrong there.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'non si trova' (is not found) is right: it is never on the priority road.

sceneParams.caption: Never on the priority road

q20541.en: The sign shown warns of a guarded level crossing with barriers.

explain.short: The X shows a crossroads, not a level crossing; a crossing with barriers has a gate symbol.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello custodito' (level crossing with barriers) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Crossroads ahead, not a level crossing

q20542.en: The sign shown comes before the GIVE WAY sign.

explain.short: At this junction there is no give way sign: the right-hand rule applies.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'DARE PRECEDENZA' is the trap: that sign has its own advance sign with a distance panel.

sceneParams.caption: No give way sign: right-hand rule

q20543.en: The sign shown comes before the STOP sign.

explain.short: At this junction there is no STOP: you give way to the right.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'STOP' is the trap: the STOP has its own advance sign 'STOP + distance'.

sceneParams.caption: No STOP: right-hand rule

q20544.en: As a rule, the sign shown is found no more than 50 metres from the junction.

explain.short: Like danger signs, outside towns it is placed about 150 m before the junction.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'non più di 50 metri' (no more than 50 m) is the trap: the normal distance is 150 m.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: about 150 m before

q20545.en: On motorways, the sign shown is placed at a distance greater than 250 metres.

explain.short: Motorways have no level junctions with priority to the right, so this sign is not used there.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'in autostrada' (on motorways) is the trap: there are no such junctions on a motorway.

sceneParams.caption: Not used on motorways

q20546.en: The sign shown announces the ST ANDREW'S CROSS sign.

explain.short: St Andrew's cross is a white-and-red X at a level crossing; this black X in a triangle is a crossroads.
explain.rule: An X in a triangle: junction ahead, give way to traffic from the right. Slow down; outside towns it is about 150 m before.
explain.trap: 'CROCE DI S. ANDREA' (St Andrew's cross) is the trap: a different X, for trains.

sceneParams.caption: Crossroads, not St Andrew's cross
